content: Melvin-Koushki says that after Shāhrukh removed Iskandar in 817/1414, Ibn Turka tried to retire from public life, sought refuge in Shiraz and Yazd, and produced there between 817-25/1414-22 his lettrist summa, the K. al-Mafāḥiṣ, and his lettrist commentary on the Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam; this period ended with his first trial in Herat in 825/1422.
